caption:
Mama had the girls up way past bedtime, all lined up in front of the camera saying hi to everybody.

Then Daddy showed up in the back of the frame. Didn't say much. Didn't have to.

Bed. Go. Bed.

And just like that, the room was empty.

Via: @officialreignkarter (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Her daughter was on the sideline in tears because the coach would not put her in the game.

Mama was not trying to hear it. You want to eat today, you better get on that field.

Coach finally called her name, and Mama says she showed out the second she got in.

Then she ate. For real this time.

Via: @risky2funny (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Kendrick met Buster at the front of the store in his blue vest. Somewhere between the jokes and the trips to the driving range, they became best friends.

Then Buster said it out loud. He lost his daughter to cancer, and he has not been this happy since she passed.

He said he knew God was gonna give him something that day.

Love you Buster.

Via: @kendrickcurry_ (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Gas station run with Grangran. Purple Hellcat at the pump, matching purple fit, cash fanned out in her hand.

Her grandson just wanted y'all to see how she moving.

She always flexing on him.

Via: @grangranofficial (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Her son was out on the ice holding on and trying to figure it out.

Then a little girl skated over, took his hand and stayed right there with him. It's okay. She's helping you.

His mama says she caught it by accident. Glad she did.

Lil bro found a real one.

Via: @chanellegiselle (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Shawn Robert Johnson did 19 years in prison before the remaining 41 years of his 60 year sentence got commuted.

Now he is sitting on the couch holding the first paycheck of his life. He is 39 years old.

He put the hours in for it. Shout out to McDonald's for giving him the chance.

One week of work. $600.

Via: @shawjohn1222 (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Everybody came walking up to the camera one by one with the same intro. I'm not the white boy. I'm the white boy neighbor. The white boy friend. The white boy cousin. The white boy girlfriend.

Then the real white boy stepped up and closed the whole thing out.

Via: @neeneecharmel (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Unk said it plain. All them junk cars sitting in yards that nobody has driven in years. Go knock and ask if you can get it for $100.

Take it to the crusher and they give you somewhere around $220 to $320. Pull the catalytic converter, the battery, the rims and the tires first and that is more money on top.

Five to six hundred profit off a $100 car. Do it ten times in a week and do the math.

Free game.

Via: @realshitinmylife (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

The OG opened up the gate and gave the whole tour.

The heart-shaped cutout in the wall. The handmade cabinets. Real wood all through the kitchen.

How he living? Like this.

Love when the OGs show out.

Via: @authentic_357dj (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

His coworkers keep asking what he got going on after work. Where he headed. What the move is.

Same answer every time. Nah. I'm going home to my wife.

Then he shows you the wife and the conversation is over.

Via: @4better4worse4real (IG)
#HustlersNTheHood

Lil man came straight from work just to show love at the stand.

Took one sip of that mango and got asked what it tastes like. He said he only knows one word in Spanish.

Delicioso.

Via: @bottom_of_theboottv (IG)
